label: class_g_04_math_01
text: The time has come to test how well you all have\nlearned here in my class![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_04_math_02
text: Let’s begin before the information simmering in\nyour brains from a last-minute cram session fades.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_04_question_01
text:
1. Which is not an effect of a picnic meal?

A) HP restoration
B) Curing poison
C) Increasing Speed
D) Gaining Meal Powers

label: class_g_04_question_02
text:
2. Which of the following affects the kinds of
    Meal Powers received from a particular meal?

A) Fillings and condiments
B) Number of people eating
C) The color of the utensils

label: class_g_04_ansewer_02c
text: C) The color of the utensils

label: class_g_04_question_03
text:
3. Which of these Berries can restore a
    Pokémon’s HP?

A) Pecha Berry
B) Cheri Berry
C) Oran Berry

label: class_g_04_question_04
text:
4. Leandro wanted his Pokémon to decide on its
    own when to use its item in battle, so he gave
    it an Oran Berry. This will work as he hopes.

A) True
B) False

label: class_g_04_question_05
text:
5. If a move runs out of PP, it can no longer be
    used. If a Pokémon runs out of PP for all its
    moves, it can only sit there in frustration.

A) True
B) False

label: class_g_04_math_03
text: The time for answering questions has come to an\nend. Please stop writing.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_04_math_04
text: I hope you were all able to give the examination\neverything you had.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
